metadata.description: Claude Code skills that build the control before the comparison.

plugins.name: strictnull
plugins.description: Degree-preserving null models for any claim that a network is non-random or more clustered than chance.

plugins.name: sameness
plugins.description: Measure whether the pages of one site share one template or look like unrelated sites.

plugins.name: searchdiff
plugins.description: Did the SEO change work? Weekly difference-in-differences on Search Console data against control pages.

plugins.name: verifygate
plugins.description: Refuse to delegate coding work to another agent unless it comes with a check that can actually fail.

plugins.name: knowledge-ledger
plugins.description: Keep a ledger, in git, of the lines the agent wrote and which of them you can explain in your own words.
